inputs.text: Calling the Rs 700 crore corruption allegations over the proposed Cooperative Department software project politically motivated does not answer them. Cooperative institutions belong to the public and depend on people’s trust, so any misuse of their money would harm the communities and members they serve. Transparency and independent accountability matter more than partisan deflection; those responsible must provide clear answers.
